FN-G80QC6-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 40
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Jim Hill
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/29/2023
House Bill 40 as introduced would revise the compensation retired justices or judges (appeals,
circuit, and district) receive when called to interim active duty status to be $780 per day, for up
to 50 days in a calendar year. This bill would increase the annual obligations of the
Administrative Office of Courts (AOC) by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference
in the current compensation paid to any such judge or justice and the compensation provided by
this bill. The estimated maximum annual compensation of a judge or justice called to active
interim duty status pursuant to this bill would be $39,000. This bill would further increase the
obligations of AOC by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of per diem and
mileage paid to any retired judge or justice recalled to active service pursuant to this bill.
In addition, this bill would increase the administrative obligations of the Chief Justice and/or the
AOC to 1) certify the need in a circuit where an interim active duty judge would serve based on
the most recent weighted caseload study; and 2) adopt policies and procedures for nominations
to the Chief Justice and duties assigned to interim active duty status justices and judges.
